summary: About 450 ready-made HyperFrames blocks and components installed as editable source - transitions, overlays, titles, kinetic type, captions, charts, map overlays, 3D, camera moves. Use it before hand-building any named visual (CRT scanlines, glitch, film grain, a chart); also for hyperframes add…
whenToUse: Use it before hand-building any named visual (CRT scanlines, glitch, film grain, a chart); also for hyperframes add and catalog.
verification: Mounted the right way for its shape, on its own ground, with GSAP and a paused root.
F1: the markup contains the named subject.
F2: motion fingerprint and markup skeleton are not both shared with a survivor.
F3: it renders something with the recipe applied, or it is protected by N3 to N6.
F4: the frames show the event the description promises.
F5: frame N is computed from N.
X1 through X8 logged with the specific fix.
Verdict cites the evidence the criterion names, not an impression.
